cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The pattern DATA_ATTR allows any character including '/' and '>' in data attributes, which can be exploited to inject malicious attributes leading to XSS
The regex pattern for data attributes allows a wide range of characters including potentially dangerous ones like '/' and '>', enabling XSS through malformed data attributes
